ticket.title: Identify sus crew
ticket.description: Everyone that the system should detect as sus is innocent and everyone who is innocent is being marked as sus.  We need to fix it so that we stop throwing innocent people out the air lock!
requirements: Return the first suspicious crew member

aiReview.summary: Compare the ticket's description of who should be returned with the condition used to select a crew member. Also consider what the requested change does not address.

proposedAnswer.reason: The code is better, but not perfect.  The SQL injection remains, but the functional requirement has been fixed.  Whether this is acceptable or not depends on your risk tolerance.
